_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sending the quote request to Haulest

description: Submits a quote request to Haulest so licensed movers can call and email the person with written estimates for the move. Haulest is not a carrier; it introduces the request to movers through its lead desk, and in the US and UK the desk may phone within minutes. Call this only after the person has given their name, phone, and email for this purpose and has explicitly agreed to be contacted (consent must be true); confirm the details back to them first. Each call creates one request; a repeat with the same phone or email within a day is recognised and not duplicated. Returns a request reference and what happens next.

consent.description: Must be true: the person has explicitly agreed that Haulest may share these details with licensed movers who will call and email about this move.

excludeMoverSlug.description: Haulest slug of a company the person does NOT want quotes from, e.g. one they already have a quote from.

from.description: Where the move starts: city and state/province, or a postcode.

moveDate.description: Planned move date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

notes.description: Anything else the movers should know: stairs, piano, elevator booking, access.

packing.description: Packing wanted: full pack, fragile only, or self pack.

phone.description: A phone number the movers may call.

name: request_moving_quotes
title: Request moving quotes
